design_vision.core_concept: Traditional Indian wedding meets high-end royal luxury. The digital experience should mimic receiving a physical, heavy-weight, foil-stamped envelope. It relies on deep moody colors, cinematic lighting, and smooth page transitions.

rules: The 'V&V' logo and subtle decorative words use Great Vibes.
Never use default sans for headings.
Ensure high contrast on the countdown timer numbers.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento Grid Mode A (Tetris Grid) adapted with arched tops for traditional Indian aesthetic.
spacing_and_layout.spacing_scale: Generous. Use p-8, p-12, p-16 for main sections. gap-8 to gap-12 for grids.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Optical center for hero. Asymmetrical offset for event cards.
spacing_and_layout.special_shapes: Use 'rounded-t-full' on event cards to mimic traditional Indian palace arches (Jharokha).

envelope_home.description: Full screen intro. A closed CSS/SVG drawn envelope on a dark emerald background with noise texture.
elements: Wax Seal: Center circle, bg-maroon_rich, shadow-xl, text 'V&V' in script font
Instruction: 'Tap to Open' in uppercase overline font below seal.
envelope_home.interaction: On click, seal breaks/fades, flap rotates up (transform origin top), entire envelope scales up and fades opacity 0 to reveal Landing Page.

landing_hero.background: Image overlay with bg-black/50 to bg-black/70 gradient.
elements: Countdown Timer: 4 transparent glassmorphism squares (Days, Hrs, Mins, Secs) to May 8, 2026
CTA Button: 'Let's Celebrate' (Solid gold bg, emerald text, hover: scale up slightly)

split_screen_modal.left_side: Groom side: Deep Emerald background. Large text 'Vishesh Kumar'. Interactive hover expands width.
split_screen_modal.right_side: Bride side: Rich Maroon background. Large text 'Veeraja'. Interactive hover expands width.
split_screen_modal.interaction: Clicking a side routes to '/groom' or '/bride'.

event_cards.description: Cards for Haldi, Mehendi, Pelli Koduku/Kuthuru, Marriage, Reception.
event_cards.styling: Arched tops (rounded-t-[100px]), gold borders. Glassmorphism or solid dark emerald.
event_cards.state_expanded: Reveals Location, Maps Link, 'Attend' / 'Not Attending' buttons.
event_cards.interaction: Attend -> Downloads .ics. Not Attending -> Show Thank You toast & redirect Home.

interactions.page_transitions: Smooth cross-fade using Framer Motion (opacity 0 to 1, duration 0.8s).
interactions.hover_states: Buttons must have hover:bg-[#F0E6D2] and text color change. Event cards lift up -translate-y-2 on hover.
interactions.noise_overlay: Global fixed pointer-events-none div with SVG noise filter to give a 'paper' texture to the whole site.

images.description: Elegant Indian couple in traditional attire. Use with heavy dark gradient overlay.
Yellow marigold flowers for pre-wedding event cards.
Royal palace architecture for the main wedding event cards.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install framer-motion. It is strictly required for the envelope opening animation and split-screen expansions.
Add Google Fonts: Cormorant Garamond, Great Vibes, and Lato to index.html.
Do NOT use standard Shadcn cards for events; build custom div structures with rounded-t-[100px] to mimic Indian architectural arches.
Ensure 'Attend' button dynamically generates a data URI for a basic .ics file based on event details.
Ensure 'Not Attending' button triggers a 'Thank You' view/toast and uses setTimeout to navigate to '/' after 3 seconds.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.
Add a fixed div with a subtle SVG noise filter to give the site a luxury paper feel.
Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 for the event cards on the Bride/Groom pages.
